decision.completeness_basis: Undergraduate Catalog A-Z Index (prints '2026-2027 Edition', current catalog.jsu.edu host, not /archive/). It lists 106 distinct bachelor entries printed as 'Name (Bachelor of ...)' plus 'STEP Program RN-BSN'; I counted 101. Excluded 5 concentrations printed alongside a base line for the same subject and award: Finance - Banking and Financial Services (base Finance BS), Geography - Geospatial Technology (base Geography BS), and Management - Human Resource Management / Management Information Systems / Project Management (base Management BS). Every other 'Subject - Concentration' line counts because it has no base line with the same award (Biology BA is a different award from the Biology BS concentrations; FCS Education BSE is a different award from the FCS BS lines). Also excluded: minors, microcredentials, certificates, courses, and the Military Science and Leadership basic/advanced course requirements (ROTC, not degrees). Of the 101 counted, 95 match verified records by URL. These 6 counted entries have no verified record: Aviation - Aviation Management (BS), Aviation - Commercial Aviation (BS), Aviation - Public Safety Aviation (BS), Economics with Approved Minor (BA), Emergency Management with a Minor in Public Safety Telecommunications (BS), and STEP Program RN-BSN. Counted although unsure: Emergency Management with a Minor (printed as its own program, not a concentration, beside base Emergency Management BS); STEP Program RN-BSN (no award printed; an RN-to-BSN completion pathway); Respiratory Therapy Bridge Program (RRT) BSRT; and the Pre-Health concentrations in Biology and in Exercise Science and Wellness, which award a BS.
